aboutGame.title: What is ArtCraft?
paragraphs: ArtCraft is an open-source desktop application for generating AI images and video, built for artists, designers, and filmmakers who want visible control instead of a black box. Instead of running in a browser tab, it installs locally and writes every render to your own drive, so prompts, references, and finished frames stay inside your pipeline.

The project describes itself as an intentional crafting engine: you steer results with detailed prompts and reference images, animate stills into motion with models such as Seedance 2.0, and extend the app because the source code is public. ArtCraft Wiki collects the guides, model notes, and workflows that help new users move from a first generation to a repeatable creative process.

faq.title: ArtCraft Wiki FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about ArtCraft Wiki and the open-source ArtCraft desktop app.

items.question: What is ArtCraft?
items.answer: ArtCraft is an open-source desktop application for generating AI images and video, built for artists, designers, and filmmakers who want control over prompts, references, and output files. ArtCraft Wiki collects the guides that help you learn it.

items.question: Is ArtCraft free and open source?
items.answer: Yes. ArtCraft is an open-source project, so the source code is public and the desktop app can be inspected, forked, and extended. ArtCraft Wiki documents how to download it and where the repository lives.

items.question: Which platforms does ArtCraft support?
items.answer: ArtCraft runs as a native desktop app on Windows, macOS, and Linux. ArtCraft Wiki keeps platform-specific install notes so you can set it up on your own machine.

items.question: What AI models does ArtCraft include?
items.answer: ArtCraft supports a large library of models for image, video, and 3D work, including the Seedance 2.0 video model. ArtCraft Wiki explains which model fits stills, animation, or multi-angle references.

items.question: Where can I get help with ArtCraft?
items.answer: The ArtCraft community shares prompt tips and workflows on Discord, Reddit, and YouTube. ArtCraft Wiki links each channel and adds step-by-step guides for common problems.
